action.prompt: The demo cases file changed. For each case in demo/cases.json without an entry in agents/cache.json, invoke the resolver against the case's difference and write the Resolution into agents/cache.json keyed by Difference.signature (NOT UUID). Each entry MUST include cache_version, validator_contract, and prompt_hash. For safe_fix=false or DECLARED_VERSION_MISMATCH, write review-only Resolution with proposed_change=None. Report added/cached cases. Do not modify core/, any adapter, or the resolver source.
